frontmatter.summary: Offline mode is asked for a third time, through sales as a line for a proposal, and still no chain has described losing a schedule

input.body:
A retail prospect with about seventy locations wants offline mode in the staff app, and the ask reached me through sales as a line for the proposal, not as a problem a store has had. That is the third time, and the shape is the same as the two before ([[people/marcus-ek]], [[research/offline-mode]]): nobody has described a chain losing a schedule to a dead connection. The February decision holds, and the claim that Åsa reopened it on 2026-07-09 has no support on the steering page ([[decisions/2026-02-12-decline-offline-mode]], [[meetings/2026-07-09-steering]]).

Marcus Ek, in #sales at 08:41 on 2026-07-17, wants an answer by Thursday 2026-07-23: "As I understood it, Åsa reopened offline mode for H2 at steering on 2026-07-09, so I'd like to tell him it's on the H2 list. Can you confirm by Thursday?"
input.rationale: The record of what was asked, so the next offline-mode question lands on it instead of starting over.

variants.label: One line to forward
variants.body:
No: offline mode is not on the H2 list, and it will not be. Åsa declined it on 2026-02-12 and the reason stands: staff already see their shifts offline, and editing a schedule offline means merging two managers' changes afterwards, most of a quarter of the team's time.

For the prospect: today the staff app keeps the current and next week on the phone, so staff see their shifts with no connection, and if the wifi drops mid-edit the change is saved and sent when it is back. Editing a whole schedule offline has no date.

variants.label: What you can tell them
variants.body:
- Today: staff see their shifts in the app with no connection. The current and next week are on the phone.
- Today: if the wifi drops while a manager is editing, the change is saved and sent when the connection is back.
- No date: editing a whole schedule offline. It is not on the H2 list, and we will not put a quarter on it.

text: The answer for Marcus is no, and it was decided on 2026-02-12: Åsa declined offline mode, the 2026-07-09 steering took no decisions, and Roadmap H2 lists it under Not doing. This is the third time it has come through sales as a line for a proposal rather than a problem a store has had. My guess, not his words: the ops director wants one sentence about what happens when a store loses its connection, and the app has one.

The reply is above in the sales voice: copy the tab you want and send it yourself. I kept a note of the request in Memory, under Insights, so the next time it comes up it lands on something. Nothing was sent and nothing waits.
